episodeTitle.en: OpenAI researcher on why soft skills are the future of work | Karina Nguyen
episodeTitle.zh: OpenAI研究员谈软技能为何是未来工作的核心 | 卡琳娜·阮

guestBioOfficial.en: Karina Nguyen leads research at OpenAI, where she’s been pivotal in developing groundbreaking products like Canvas, Tasks, and the o1 language model. Before OpenAI, Karina was at Anthropic, where she led post-training and evaluation work for Claude 3 models, created a document upload feature with 100,000 context windows, and contributed to numerous other innovations. With experience as an engineer at the New York Times and as a designer at Dropbox and Square, Karina has a rare firsthand perspective on the cutting edge of AI and large language models. In our conversation, we discuss: • How OpenAI builds product
guestBioOfficial.zh: 卡琳娜·阮在OpenAI领导研究工作，曾在Anthropic为Claude 3模型开发培训后评估工具，创建支持10万个上下文窗口的文档上传功能，并为多项创新做出贡献。她在《纽约时报》担任工程师，以及在Dropbox和Square担任设计师的经历，使她对AI和大语言模型的前沿技术有着难得的第一手视角。在我们的对话中，我们讨论了：• OpenAI如何打造产品

title.en: OpenAI researcher on why soft skills are the future of work | Karina Nguyen
title.zh: OpenAI研究员谈软技能为何是未来工作的核心 | 卡琳娜·阮

summary.en: Karina explains how her love of front-end engineering evolved into AI research as she realized models could build apps themselves. She argues that creative, aesthetic judgment is still hard to teach models and remains a key human skill. The episode demystifies how large language models are actually created and where human taste still matters most.
summary.zh: 卡琳娜讲述了她对前端工程的热爱如何随着"模型能自己构建应用"的认知而转向 AI 研究。她认为，创造性与审美判断仍难以教给模型，依然是人类的关键能力。本期揭开了大语言模型真实构建过程的神秘面纱，并指出人类品味在何处最为关键。
